messages.subject: For Bernard Fontana | Low-carbon power, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear EDF Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Bernard Fontana, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

EDF's low-carbon power and infrastructure agenda requires disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, communities and major investment programs. That interface closely matches the work I lead today in a complex regulated environment.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, stakeholder strategy and energy-transition experience might support EDF's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to EDF.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
